revision_reason: The first outcome-free recipe freeze exposed that broad test-directory membership can select support modules such as tests/models.py or conftest.py. Before execution, task-validity targets are restricted to executable test modules named test_*.py or *_test.py.
purpose: Acquire primary temporal executable tasks by validating task semantics and E2 support at collection time instead of recovering execution support later.

task_validity_contract.frozen_test_source: changed Python test files from the merge commit
task_validity_contract.executable_test_path_rule: Python basename starts with test_ or ends with _test.py; test-support modules alone cannot establish task validity
task_validity_contract.merge_requirement: frozen changed tests pass on the merge commit
task_validity_contract.parent_requirement: the same merge-commit tests fail when overlaid onto the first parent commit
task_validity_contract.parent_build_requirement: parent plus frozen test overlay builds successfully before the expected test failure

development_acquisition_snapshots.repository_discovery_rule: Authenticated GitHub repository search using the frozen allowed-license Python queries; exclude every repository in the existing broad frozen manifest and every benchmark-source repository before task discovery
development_acquisition_snapshots.task_selection_rule: At most one first metadata-eligible code_and_test or test_only merged pull request per repository, using paths and commit identities only
development_acquisition_snapshots.repository_reuse_across_development_snap: deduplicate by repository identity and pull-request number before any execution outcome
development_acquisition_snapshots.project_metadata_and_execution_outcomes: forbidden until the snapshot candidate list is frozen

development_accumulation_amendment.basis: The pre-existing forward-pilot productivity report estimated 4,336 metadata candidates for the 542-task development target; a 200-repository bounded snapshot was never sufficient as the continuing acquisition frame
development_accumulation_amendment.later_snapshot_repository_rule: scan every eligible fresh repository from the frozen authenticated discovery artifact, up to the pre-frozen 1,200-repository discovery cap
development_accumulation_amendment.cadence: incremental snapshots on later calendar dates through 2026-08-31
development_accumulation_amendment.same_repository_multiple_tasks: forbidden for the primary development aggregate

development_discovery_capacity_amendment.basis: The frozen one-task-per-repository rule caps the 759-repository frame at 759 metadata candidates and approximately 94 E2 tasks at the pre-existing 0.125 pilot yield, below the frozen 542-task development target
development_discovery_capacity_amendment.query_rule: keep the same Python, non-fork, non-archived, pushed-since, stars>=20, and allowlisted-license queries
development_discovery_capacity_amendment.expanded_frame_success_condition: fresh repository count must be at least the point-estimate development metadata-candidate requirement; otherwise explicitly abstain on structural capacity
development_discovery_capacity_amendment.shortfall_action: expand source coverage under a separately frozen rule or abstain; never weaken task validity or one-task-per-repository

development_source_coverage_amendment.basis: Exhausting the unchanged stars>=20 GitHub query depth produced 3,552 fresh repositories, below the pre-existing 4,336 point-estimate metadata-candidate requirement
development_source_coverage_amendment.scientific_rationale: Repository popularity is not a protocol eligibility requirement and excluding low-star repositories would narrow the intended raw-data operating claim
development_source_coverage_amendment.shortfall_action: abstain on structural capacity or freeze another source family before its metadata

development_operations_contract.repository_task_choice: earliest merge timestamp then pull-request number

retrospective_development_contract.purpose: Use already-public post-base-release GitHub pull requests for development task acquisition while preserving future tasks for untouched confirmation
retrospective_development_contract.repository_frame_source: frozen 5,000-repository fresh frame disjoint from the entire existing broad repository manifest and benchmark-source repositories
retrospective_development_contract.task_selection_rule: first strict metadata-eligible code_and_test or test_only task under the frozen GitHub query and path rule

selection_uses: existing train split for infrastructure-pilot quarantine
selection_forbids: file content except allowlisted project metadata used to freeze execution recipes
test execution outcomes before candidate and recipe freeze
pilot_success_interpretation: Infrastructure productivity evidence only; pilot tasks are quarantined from development and confirmatory evaluation.
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Forward E2 task-acquisition contract only; no Utility, curation-benefit, or release claim.
